calmRetuning.selectionRule: CALM tuning uses only pre-2024 development data: 2018-2021 training plus 2022-2023 calibration. 2024-2025 and 2026+ remain untouched confirmation slices. Pick the lowest score threshold that clears the calibration gates with >=30 samples while training remains >=50% win rate. Setup/sector exclusions are allowed only when the same subgroup is <45% win rate with >=12 samples in both training and calibration.

method: Chronological barrier study sampled every 10 trading days. CALM profile selection uses only pre-2024 development data split into 2018-2021 training and 2022-2023 calibration. 2024-2025 is untouched holdout 1 and 2026+ is untouched holdout 2. MIXED signals are disabled. A 20-trading-day 2.6R target horizon is used. Historical evidence is not a guarantee.

CALM.reason: At least one adequately sampled untouched holdout failed a robustness gate.

VOLATILE.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

TRENDING_DOWN.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

TRENDING_UP.reason: Both untouched holdouts remained positive under the regime-specific entry profile.

MIXED.reason: MIXED is intentionally disabled because development performance is non-viable.

UNKNOWN.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

instructions: Do not tune from either holdout. CALM must earn promotion on pre-2024 calibration then survive both untouched slices. MIXED stays disabled. VOLATILE, TRENDING_DOWN and UNKNOWN stay reduced while sparse. TRENDING_UP is the highest research priority because both untouched slices currently confirm it.
